# Functions: fn, calls, arity, builtins as values, higher-order use.

=== identity
((fn (x) x) 42)
--- want
42

=== no parameters
((fn () 1))
--- want
1

=== body is a sequence
((fn (x) (set x (+ x 1)) x) 1)
--- want
2

=== arity mismatch too many
((fn (x) x) 1 2)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== arity mismatch too few
((fn (x y) x) 1)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== fn needs parameters and body
(fn)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== fn needs a body
(fn (x))
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== fn parameters must be symbols
((fn (1) 1) 2)
--- error
--- at 1:2

=== calling a number
(1 2)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== calling a string
("a")
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== calling the result of a call
((+ 1 2) 3)
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== empty list expression
()
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== builtin is a function value
(type-of +)
--- want
"func"

=== builtin passed as an argument
(fold + 0 (list 1 2))
--- want
3

=== builtin mapped over a list
(map - (list 1 2))
--- want
(list -1 -2)

=== builtin as a value is the same value every time
(= + +)
--- want
#t

=== builtin as a value differs from another builtin
(= + -)
--- want
#f

=== builtin stored in a global and called
(do (def add +) (add 2 3))
--- want
5

=== builtin chosen by an expression and called
((if #t + -) 5 2)
--- want
7

=== builtin called as a value fails as the builtin
((if #t + -) 1 "a")
--- error
--- at 1:1

=== builtin as a value keeps each call's arguments apart
(map list (list 1 2))
--- want
(list (list 1) (list 2))

=== function is a value
(type-of (fn (x) x))
--- want
"func"

=== function stored in a global
(do (def sq (fn (x) (* x x))) (sq 7))
--- want
49

=== function stored in a local
(let ((sq (fn (x) (* x x)))) (sq 7))
--- want
49

=== function passed to a function
(let ((apply (fn (f x) (f x)))) (apply (fn (n) (+ n 1)) 41))
--- want
42

=== function returned from a function
(((fn () (fn (x) (* x 3)))) 5)
--- want
15

=== argument evaluation order is left to right
(do
  (set log (list))
  (def note (fn (x) (set log (list-append log x)) x))
  ((fn (a b c) log) (note 1) (note 2) (note 3)))
--- want
(list 1 2 3)

=== arguments are evaluated before the body runs
((fn (a b) (+ a b)) (* 2 3) (* 4 5))
--- want
26

=== error inside an argument propagates
((fn (x) x) (/ 1 0))
--- error
--- at 1:13

=== error inside the body propagates
((fn (x) (/ x 0)) 1)
--- error
--- at 1:10
